data.content_ref: inline:Kind: Reduction. The normative preference described in the isolated node reduces to the descriptive fact of 'community survival' outlined in SRC_001. What scientists call 'rational preference' is nothing more than the sociological phenomenon of research groups adopting methods that prevent their extinction. Refuted If: A rational agent is identified who consistently prefers corroborated theories despite belonging to a community that would survive equally well by preferring non-corroborated ones, proving the preference is not reducible to community survival mechanics.
